race.description: The Ville Mayor's Cup Open Hcp
race.comment: SIGIRIYA ROCK (4) was below his best when finishing ninth fresh up at Mackay over 1300m last start, but that effort can be overlooked. He was formerly very consistent when racing in Victoria, and we expect him to improve sharply, and be the one to beat this time. PRINCE AKEEM (7) was not far away in his latest outing at this track and looks suited stepping up in distance. He has been a durable veteran for a long time, and from a good draw, he will be hard to hold out. EL PENSADOR (9) is nearing peak fitness after another honest effort for fifth at Mackay last start just over 2 weeks ago. He has been holding his form strongly deep into this prep, and he can figure in the top 3. CIFONELLI (11) caught the eye with a strong closing effort to finish close up in third here last start. He seldom puts a hoof wrong, and another big run is on the cards. ACROPHOBIC (1) has been struggling to find his best form this prep, but he is top weight in this for a reason. Don't drop him yet.
